assertions.save: Real two-frame drawing; per-frame layer counts 1/2 and Blue Mark identity; 100/200ms holds; explicit save confirmation and actual page reload; complete project equality and decoded PNGs for both poses.
assertions.svg: Visible approximation guidance, 4x/64x64 output, actual XML namespace/dimensions/nonempty emitted geometry; no pixel-exact vector reconstruction claim; exact protected project/artwork.
assertions.cycle: Admitted Bun, UI Scan Canvas palette verified against actual source colors; inclusive range 2..5, both outside colors and alpha protected across at least three observed phases; native 6/5.5/5.6 validity; pause/exact project, single Undo to 5.5 and Redo to 6; safe track deletion.
assertions.pocket: Real 390x844 Studio gate/Pocket navigation, selected swatch, two literal pen marks and one erased mark, all 4096 channels, independently decoded real PNG, Clear/Home. Desktop viewport simulation, not physical touch.
